'''Mekks''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. By [[3643 BBY]] he worked as a comm officer in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of an industrial [[City/Legends|town]] named [[Jiguuna]]. Prior to this, he had also come to owe a woman named [[Gianna]] a favor. Mekks repaid the favor in 3643 BBY when he saw her son, [[Zi'am]], and her husband, [[Kendrel]], in the spaceport attempting to flee the planet. The pair were trying to escape Hutta, as Gianna wished for Zi'am, who was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], to train on the planet [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] to become [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Kendrel, who had trained on Korriban himself but failed and fled, did not want Zi'am to suffer the same experience he'd had and so was trying to take his son to safety. Mekks then directed an Imperial-aligned individual Gianna had hired to retrieve Zi'am to the pair's location. He then witnessed the individual kill Kendrel after he refused to give up his son.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Huh. You're the one Gianna recruited to rescue her son? She said you were on your way.|Mekks greets the individual Gianna hired.|<ref name="Dreams" />}}
Mekks was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Dreams" /> Some time before or during [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> he came to work as a comm officer on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] within a spaceport in a small industrial town named [[Jiguuna]]. He also came to owe a favor to a woman named [[Gianna]]. In 3643 BBY, Mekks recognized Gianna's husband, [[Kendrel]], and son, [[Zi'am]], in the spaceport preparing to depart. He informed Gianna of their whereabouts, as Gianna was looking for them. Kendrel, who had previously trained on Korriban himself but failed his trials and fled, was attempting to take Zi'am away from Gianna to prevent her from sending their son to his potential death, as he too was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. Once Gianna received Mekks' message, she began seeking help to retrieve her son.<ref name="Dreams" />

[[File:The_men_in_Giannas_life.png|thumb|left|Mekks, Kendrel and Zi'am in the Jiguuna spaceport.|200px]]
{{GameDSmechanics}}
Gianna eventually sent an Imperial-aligned individual to retrieve her son. The individual found Mekks in the spaceport and the comm officer told them that he would point out Kendrel and Zi'am, but not aid in claiming the boy. He called over the pair, but once the individual explained why they were there, Kendrel refused to hand over his son. The father asked that the individual let them flee and tell Gianna they had gone to Korriban so she wouldn't search for them. The individual refused and shot Kendrel, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him before before he could react. After his father's death, Zi'am fled home to his mother and Mekks, believing he had settled his debt, left the hunter to return to his work.<ref name="Dreams" /> Gianna later sent Zi'am to Korriban as she had planned.<ref name="SWTORMail">{{TORcite|type=message|Zi'am on Korriban|Harkun}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|That was... nevermind. Not my business|Mekks, after witnessing Kendrel's death|<ref name="Dreams" />}}
Mekks honored the debt he owed to Gianna by informing of her of her son's whereabouts, but he refused to help the individual retrieve him as he did not want to risk being hurt by Kendrel, who he believed looked suspicious. After Mekks witnessed Kendrel's death, he considered commenting on it but refrained as he didn't believe it was his business.<ref name="Dreams" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I'm through with you and Gianna. Don't get me involved again.|Mekks becomes more angry in another dialogue option.|<ref name="Dreams" />}}
Mekks first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]]. He is involved in the quest "Dreams of Korriban" on Hutta, where he directs the player to Zi'am and Kendrel after Gianna asks the player to find them. The player has a choice to either allow Kendrel and Zi'am to flee once they reach the spaceport ([[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]]) or to kill Kendrel ([[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]). This article assumes that the player chose to take the "dark side" option and killed Kendral due to the fact only Imperial characters of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty Hunter]] or [[Imperial Agent]] class can undertake this quest. This is due to its location on Nal Hutta, which [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] players cannot access.<ref name="Dreams" />
